description: Permanently deletes the specified saved account board when the user requests its removal. Requires explicit boards:delete authorization and personal ownership or organization owner/admin access; guest boards are unsupported. Read get_board first and pass its current revision. Deletion cancels active generation jobs and cannot be undone. A revision conflict requires reading the board again. Missing, already deleted or inaccessible boards return the same not_found error; this does not confirm that an earlier request succeeded. No requestId or replay receipt is supported.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

expectedRevision.description: Latest saved revision from create_board, update_board or get_board. Reuse it if no intervening change is known. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before preparing a new operation.

name: delete_board
title: Permanently delete an account board
